reader_summary.headline: Ian Charles and Doc O'Connor are the Co-Founders and Managing Partners of Arctos Sports Partners.
reader_summary.overview: Ian Charles and Doc O'Connor are the Co-Founders and Managing Partners of Arctos Sports Partners. From its founding just two years ago, Arctos quickly has become the market leader in the space. Our conversation covers their backgrounds and the formation of Arctos, the investment opportunity in sports franchises, and the underlying business and ownership structure.
